**Estimating Specific Tasks**

technical_and_design_decisions: Upgrade Reactor dependency to 2.0.3 in the build configuration files and resolve any API deprecations or binary compatibility issues.
Change the default configuration setting for `xd.jmx.enabled` (or equivalent spring/xd property) to false while keeping override capabilities via environment variables and CLI parameters.
Modify RPM init/service scripts to accept an instance identifier parameter, calculating port offsets and using unique PID/log file locations for concurrent xd-container executions on the same host.
Fix Gradle distribution configuration tasks (`dist` and `distZip`) by updating task dependencies, archive path definitions, and artifact inclusion rules.

Execute benchmark suites for Kafka 0.8.1 and 0.8.2 using baseline, Tuple, and Serialized payloads against the 3 required transport-to-sink pathways (In-Memory > HDFS, Direct Binding > HDFS, Kafka > HDFS).
Perform code cleanup across the codebase to suppress or fix javac compiler warnings and javadoc syntax errors.
assumptions: A dedicated test environment with HDFS and Kafka cluster instances is available for performance benchmarking.
Gradle is the primary build tool used for managing dependencies, compilation, and distribution packaging.
Documentation is maintained in standard project markup format (Asciidoc or Markdown) alongside source code.
The developer will execute unit tests, integration tests, and manual verification for all updated features.

activities.activity_description: Configure test harness and execute performance benchmark runs for baseline, Tuple, and Serialized payloads across In-Memory > HDFS, Direct Binding > HDFS, and Kafka > HDFS sinks to compare Kafka 0.8.1 and 0.8.2 performance.
Update Reactor dependency version to 2.0.3 in build scripts, adapt any affected API calls in Spring XD, and run regression tests.
Update default container configuration properties to set JMX to disabled by default, updating test cases that rely on JMX functionality.

activities.activity_name: Gradle dist and distZip Build Fixes
activities.activity_description: Investigate and resolve issues with `./gradlew dist` and `distZip` tasks, ensuring distribution archives generate correctly and publish builds succeed.
Resolve compiler warnings (generics, deprecations) and fix Javadoc formatting/missing tag warnings across the project modules.
Enhance RPM startup scripts to support launching multiple xd-container instances on a single node with unique instance identifiers, ports, and PID files.
Update documentation for Out-Of-The-Box (OOTB) batch jobs, adding explicit section anchors and detailed job usage descriptions.
Write and update documentation for the UI Analytics tab widgets and streaming pipeline metric visualizers.
Perform full automated build verification, RPM deployment smoke testing, and regression testing across the updated software increment.
